method: Source-diff review of src/routes/links/+page.svelte, the only file under this surface's declared sourceRoots (src/routes, src/lib/components) that changed. The card title now shows the event/matchup segment instead of the full standard-format album name, with any recognized level/division/sport prefix (e.g. 'HS Girls VB') moved to a small secondary line above it, and any trailing date segment that duplicates the date-count line dropped — parsed by splitAlbumNameForDisplay in src/lib/utils/canonical-album-naming.ts (outside this surface's sourceRoots, no visitor-facing copy of its own, covered by 18 unit tests including all 6 currently-live albums from /photography/api/galleries/recent). The lead card's image alt text still uses the full raw album_name, unchanged. No album name text is rewritten, only re-partitioned; reader-contract.json's 'album and event names' precision lock holds. A live 390px walk of /photography/links on the Cloudflare Pages branch preview follows this receipt.
